claims.statement: For symmetric 4x4 B with lambda_3(B)<=-L, either some principal pair is negative definite with determinant >=(17/1000)L^2, or every principal triple has sigma_min >=(949/2000)L. Positive same-sign case follows by reflection.

For four independent density<=1 coordinates, any symmetric 4x4 B with at least three eigenvalues all <=-L or all >=L, and arbitrary fourth eigenvalue, has affine-quadratic output density <=C_same/L with C_same<24.193.
For n>=4, if at least n-1 eigenvalues of A are all <=-L or all >=L and the remaining eigenvalue is arbitrary, then independent density<=1 inputs give ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity<C_same/L<24.193/L.
